title: Tangent to a Circle — Properties — Circles
hook: Let's explore Tangent to a Circle — Properties from the chapter on Circles. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Tangent to a Circle — Properties A tangent to a circle touches it at exactly one point. The tangent at any point is perpendicular to the radius at that point of contact. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Tangent touches the circle at exactly one point (point of contact/tangency)
💡 Theorem 1: Tangent ⊥ Radius at the point of contact
💡 A line perpendicular to the radius at its endpoint on the circle is a tangent
💡 No tangent can be drawn from a point inside the circle
